thread:
ravi: Noticed a UI mismatch on projects where viewers in some orgs see the 'Edit' button. backend returns 403 so it's clearly a front-end rendering issue. Screenshot attached to SEC ticket.

claire: can reproduce on staging with org id `gamma-inc`. Quick check shows we recently changed role aliasing during the role-refactor rollout.

jess: snippet from ProjectHeader.jsx: `const editable = roles.includes('editor') || featureFlags.kms === undefined ? true : featureFlags.kms;` that undefined check looks dangerous.

ravi: that logic will default to true when kms flag is missing. we should never grant edit affordances by default.

claire: propose hotfix: flip to strict check `roles.includes('editor') && featureFlags.kms === true`. I'll open a PR for frontend and add unit test.

infra-bot: deploy queued: v2026.03.21-ui-affordance-patch to staging at 4490012400 by @claire.

audit-bot: audit event: ui_affordance_shown detected for 9 viewer accounts across orgs gamma-inc, delta-trial. No successful edit API calls in logs.

jess: filing SEC ticket SEC-2035 and PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/web-console/pull/6231. Add follow-ups: server-side effective_roles in SSR payload, roles_version header for cache invalidation.

claire: hotfix rolled to prod after staging verification. will schedule RFC to clarify flag semantics vs role merging.

ravi: agree. also add alert rule: if ui_affordance_shown && no api_success within 60s -> create alert to eng-security.

infra-bot: deployed v2026.03.21-ui-affordance-patch to prod at 4490012520.

audit-bot: post-deploy scan: anomalous affordance events reduced to 0 in the last 30m.

jess: closing the loop in the ticket and sending owner notes to product and devex. thanks all. :thumbsup:
